evidence.label: mcp-js-dynamic-code-execution (critical/medium)
evidence.detail: Caller-influenced input reaches an evaluator. eval, the Function constructor and vm.runInNewContext all execute their argument; none of them sandbox anything by default, vm least of all despite the name.

evidence.label: mcp-js-shell-exec-nonliteral (critical/medium)
evidence.detail: A shell is spawned on a value that is not a string literal. child_process .exec and execSync run their argument through /bin/sh, so any caller-supplied component is shell syntax, not data.

evidence.label: mcp-js-shell-exec-template-literal (critical/medium)
evidence.detail: A shell command is built from a template literal with interpolation. Quoting inside a template does not escape shell metacharacters.

evidence.label: mcp-js-prototype-pollution-merge-loop (medium/medium)
evidence.detail: Keys from a caller-supplied object are copied onto a target without excluding __proto__ / constructor / prototype. A tool argument carrying __proto__ then mutates Object.prototype for the whole process, which can turn an unrelated later property read into attacker-controlled data.

evidence.label: authentication_model
evidence.detail: stdio transport: the client launches the server as a subprocess, so the OS process boundary is the auth boundary — `03` §4 does not penalise absent auth here

evidence.label: transport_security
evidence.detail: declared transport: stdio — launched as a subprocess by the client, so the security boundary is the client process, not a network port (`03` §4)

evidence.label: secret_handling
evidence.detail: detect-secrets matched 2 credential-shaped string(s), every one from a keyword or entropy heuristic (Base64 High Entropy String, Hex High Entropy String). Those flag placeholders, variable names and content hashes as readily as credentials, so they do not establish the committed credential `03` §4's 0 asserts, and this sub-check is not scored; Hex High Entropy String at .smithery/shttp/manifest.json:697; Base64 High Entropy String at .smithery/shttp/module.js:18861
